points.title: Kitna rakhna hai?
points.text: Aam rule: 3 se 6 mahine ke zaroori kharche alag rakho.

points.title: Kahan rakhna hai?
points.text: Aisi jagah jahan se turant nikal sako, risky jagah bilkul nahi.

points.title: Sirf emergency ke liye
points.text: Job loss ya hospital ke liye. Sale ya trip ke liye nahi!

takeaway: Emergency fund aapka financial seatbelt hai.
